visual_elements.description: ROC curve plot. Y-axis labeled TPR (red, vertical). X-axis labeled FPR (red, horizontal). Origin at bottom-left. Multiple curves originate at (0,0) and end near top-right (1,1). Top curve is magenta/purple with white circular markers, bowing toward top-left corner; yellow shaded area beneath it. Middle curve is green with markers. Lower curve is blue with markers. Several thin straight green lines radiate from origin toward top-right. A dark blue line goes from origin to top-right corner. Grid lines visible in light gray. Annotation 'Best Model Largest Area Under the Curve' in magenta text with two magenta arrows pointing to the top purple curve. Annotation 'Worst Model Smallest Area Under the Curve' in dark blue text on the right with two dark blue arrows pointing to lower curves/lines.

recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to light gray (#f0f0f0).
2. Add a thin maroon rectangular border around the slide content area.
3. Add a black horizontal strip across the very bottom edge.
4. Add title text 'Area Under the Curve (AUC)' centered at the top in bold red sans-serif, larger than body text.
5. Add a yellow circle containing the number '37' in black at the top-right corner.
6. Add a white rectangle text box in the upper middle spanning most of the slide width.
7. Inside the text box, add a blue bold header line: 'Compare between different models (at different thresholds for each model)'.
8. Inside the text box, add a black body line: 'Best Model is the model trying to reach the point at [FBR=0, TPR=1]'.
9. Inside the text box, add a black body line: 'In other words, Best model is the model that has the largest area under the curve'.
10. Insert an ROC line chart centered in the lower-middle (roughly x: 27%-66%, y: 41%-93%) with light gray grid lines.
11. Add Y-axis label 'TPR' in red on the left side of the chart.
12. Add X-axis label 'FPR' in red at the bottom of the chart.
13. Plot a magenta/purple curve originating at (0,0), bowing toward the top-left corner, and ending near (1,1), with white circular markers.
14. Fill the area beneath the magenta curve with yellow shading.
15. Plot a green curve with markers below the magenta curve.
16. Plot a blue curve with markers below the green curve.
17. Draw several thin straight green lines radiating from the origin toward the top-right.
18. Draw a dark blue diagonal line from the origin to the top-right corner.
19. Add magenta text annotation 'Best Model Largest Area Under the Curve' above the magenta curve with two magenta arrows pointing down to it.
20. Add dark blue text annotation 'Worst Model Smallest Area Under the Curve' on the right side with two dark blue arrows pointing to the lower curves/lines.
